title: The seven apples
description: A mod that extends the concept of the golden apple and add 1 for each mineral
body:
**The Seven Apples** expands Minecraft’s survival by introducing six new mystical apples alongside the classic golden one.

Each apple is crafted with its respective material _Amethyst, Copper, Diamond, Emerald, Iron, and Lapis Lazuli_ and grants powerful, unique buffs when eaten.
- ![Golden Apple – The classic healing artifact.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/28eaddf27348af8d4f3ba0a6aad7642efd90e3e6.webp) Golden Apple – The classic healing artifact.
- ![Amethyst Apple – Absorption III (45s).](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d3d7cedc668ab1b9f387a2caf03acb45228a9062.png) Amethyst Apple – Absorption III (45s).
- ![Copper Apple – Resistance III (15s) and Speed I (25s).](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/47584223a73d7da182120ca9239b10337f8206ed.png) Copper Apple – Resistance III (15s) and Speed I (25s).
- ![Diamond Apple – The ultimate defense: Absorption IV, Speed IV, Fire Resistance I, Water Breathing I, Jump Boost II, Regeneration III (all 40s).](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/29e348739a90a789c6dfeae80d582959d83e2073.png) Diamond Apple – The ultimate defense: Absorption IV, Speed IV, Fire Resistance I, Water Breathing I, Jump Boost II, Regeneration III (all 40s).
- ![Emerald Apple – Saturation V (15s).](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9712cd3b1483f1bf9769163d259638c6402c050e.png) Emerald Apple – Saturation V (15s).
- ![Iron Apple – Resistance IV (30s).](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/889650b3080e2c945cc7c26bda7edaa3498f5624.png) Iron Apple – Resistance IV (30s).
- ![Lapis Apple – Strength IV and Haste IV (30s each).](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3987b537e6ff0623f6a57e3b6a704d1232e523e6.png) Lapis Apple – Strength IV and Haste IV (30s each).
